measurements.dense_execution: one output neuron per SIMDgroup, up to eight SIMDgroups per threadgroup

known_release_blockers: Dense PolicyIR is SIMDgroup-parallel but does not yet use shape-specialized SIMDgroup matrix tiles or reduced-precision weight storage.
PolicyIR has no convolutional, residual, normalization, recurrent, or attention operators.
Recurrent policy state and reset masks are not part of the native session contract.
Policy installation does not yet use inactive private weight banks and atomic revision swaps.
No production native adjoint or discontinuity-validity API exists.
The G1 policy is not standing or walking qualification evidence.
The ten-million-transition release soak has not run.
